pertanyaan: Tampilkan data gap/perbedaan hasil pengawasan penandaan obat antara pusat dan UPT
sql:
SELECT 
    mp.tgl_start,
    mp.kesimpulan_penilaian_balai,
    mp.kesimpulan_penilaian_pusat,
    COUNT(*) AS jumlah_gap
FROM mv_penandaan mp
WHERE mp.kesimpulan_penilaian_balai IS NOT NULL
  AND mp.kesimpulan_penilaian_pusat IS NOT NULL
  AND mp.kesimpulan_penilaian_balai <> mp.kesimpulan_penilaian_pusat
GROUP BY 
    mp.tgl_start,
    mp.kesimpulan_penilaian_balai,
    mp.kesimpulan_penilaian_pusat
ORDER BY 
    mp.tgl_start;

pertanyaan: Tampilkan data pemenuhan timeline pengawasan oleh masing-masing UPT yang dapat diukur seja
sql:
select mp.nama_balai, mp.id, mpt.tgl_start, mpt.tanggal_kirim_pusat, (mpt.mulai_kabalai + mpt.kabalai_direktur + mpt.direktur_pusat) as durasi_hari
from mv_penandaan mp 
join mv_penandaan_timeline mpt 
on mp.id = mpt.id_penandaan 
where tanggal_kirim_direktur is not null
order by 1, 2

pertanyaan: Tampilkan jumlah label tepat waktu yang telah dikirimkan ke pusat pada UPT tertentu pada r
sql:
SELECT 
    mp.nama_balai,
    COUNT(*) AS jumlah_laporan,
    SUM(
        CASE 
            WHEN mpt.tanggal_kirim_kabalai < (DATE_TRUNC('month', mp.tgl_start) + INTERVAL '1 month' + INTERVAL '14 day') 
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 
        END
    ) AS laporan_tepat_waktu,
    ROUND(
        SUM(
            CASE 
                WHEN mpt.tanggal_kirim_kabalai < (DATE_TRUNC('month', mp.tgl_start) + INTERVAL '1 month' + INTERVAL '14 day') 
                THEN 1 ELSE 0 
            END
        )::DECIMAL / COUNT(*) * 100, 
        2
    ) AS persentase_tepat_waktu
FROM mv_penandaan mp
JOIN mv_penandaan_timeline mpt 
    ON mp.id = mpt.id_penandaan
WHERE 
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM mpt.tanggal_kirim_kabalai) = 2025
GROUP BY mp.nama_balai
ORDER BY mp.nama_balai;

pertanyaan: Berdasarkan kata kunci nama produsen tertentu, tampilkan berapa jumlah label yang dilapork
sql:
select 
    mp.pendaftar,
    count(*) as total_laporan,
    sum(case when lower(mp.kesimpulan_penilaian_pusat) = 'mk' then 1 else 0 end) as jumlah_mk_pusat,
    sum(case when lower(mp.kesimpulan_penilaian_pusat) = 'tmk' then 1 else 0 end) as jumlah_tmk_pusat,
    sum(case when lower(mp.kesimpulan_penilaian_balai) = 'mk' then 1 else 0 end) as jumlah_mk_balai,
    sum(case when lower(mp.kesimpulan_penilaian_balai) = 'tmk' then 1 else 0 end) as jumlah_tmk_balai,
    sum(case 
        when lower(mp.kesimpulan_penilaian_balai) <> lower(mp.kesimpulan_penilaian_pusat)
             and mp.kesimpulan_penilaian_balai is not null 
             and mp.kesimpulan_penilaian_pusat is not null 
        then 1 else 0 end) as jumlah_perbedaan_balai_pusat
from mv_penandaan mp 
where lower(mp.pendaftar) like '%dua kelinci%'
  and mp.kesimpulan_penilaian_pusat is not null
group by mp.pendaftar
order by total_laporan desc;
